rule_notes: NIKL MCFAQ 5716 directly attests 삶의[살믜]/[살메] under §5(다만 4). NIKL §5 commentary excludes [i] when a preceding coda resyllabifies into the onset before ㅢ; therefore [살믜] is rendered /mɰi/, not /mi/. The alternate [살메] is /me/. Park et al. (2016) find [e] in 602/628 monophthongized genitive tokens (95.86%) in Seoul Corpus; this is population evidence, not speaker-specific. Ukrainian ɰi mapping remains provisional.
variant_note: NIKL explicitly permits both Hangul readings; IPA is project-rendered; speaker-specific variant is unselected.
